name: Junya Watanabe
why: The remix master of the Comme des Garçons house — patchwork denim and American workwear icons rebuilt as couture; the menswear obsessive's grail tier.
origin: Junya Watanabe, Tokyo — Kawakubo's protégé with his own line under Comme des Garçons since 1992; rebuilds Levi's, Carhartt, and The North Face with their blessing.
opview: Famously says almost nothing in interviews — the remixes are the statement.

onething.n: SSENSE designer page; via Mr Porter

notes.denim: patchwork denim and sanctioned Levi's rebuilds — the collaboration as art form
notes.style: the remix as a design philosophy — familiar icons made strange
notes.avant: the remix as formal invention — familiar icons made strange
notes.weird: Spliced garments and seams that should not close. The weirdness is engineering — a technical problem set and then solved in public.

cities: Dover Street Market · top specialty & e-tail — no own stores

marks: No own store exists, so nothing can be credited to an own site.
